name: Anti-magic religion
description: A religion that came to power blaming magic and its users for the Sylex Blast and its effects.

timeline.summary: An anti-magic religion came to power, blaming magic and its users for the blast.
timeline.quote: an anti-magic religion comes to power, blaming the Sylex blast and its effects on all magic and its users

timeline.summary: Persecution of wizards led to the creation of the City of Shadows and the Conclave of Mages, where they hid.
timeline.quote: Persecution of these magic-using wizards led to the creation of the fabled City of Shadows in the east and the Conclave of Mages in the west
